faq.title: Help / FAQ
faq.howItWorks3: 3. Book a worker and confirm the booking.
faq.howItWorks4: 4. The worker arrives, you share the OTP, work begins.
faq.howItWorks5: 5. Work is done — pay after service.
faq.paymentText: Pay after service in cash or via UPI.
faq.safetyText: All workers are verified with Aadhaar before onboarding.
faq.supportText: Contact us at +91 9949363310 for any help.
faq.employerA1: Post your requirement on the app — nearby verified workers will appear. View the profile, hire, and after the work is completed pay the worker directly in cash or via UPI.
faq.employerA2: Yes, every worker's phone number and ID are verified. After a completed job, ratings and reviews also build trust.
faq.employerQ3: How do I make the payment?
faq.employerA3: Payment is direct — pay the worker in cash or via UPI once the work is completed. SahiKaarigar has no in-app payment, escrow, or wallet. Platform fee ₹0 — no commission is cut.
faq.employerA4: Yes, your phone number is never shown to the worker directly. All communication happens through the app until the hire is confirmed.
faq.workerA1: Download the app and tap "Join as Kaarigar". Fill in your name, phone, skills and area — verify the OTP and your account is ready.
faq.workerA2: After the work is completed the customer pays you directly in cash or via UPI. SahiKaarigar has no commission, wallet, or payout system. Platform fee ₹0 — you receive the full amount.
faq.workerQ3: How do I get more jobs?
faq.workerA3: Keep your profile complete, maintain good ratings and reviews, and set availability to "Available" — nearby employers will see your profile more often.
faq.workerA4: OTP verification is instant. ID and skill verification usually takes 24-48 hours — after that you can be hired.
faq.contactWhatsApp: Still need help? Contact WhatsApp Support
